name: Dataflows - Performance: Disable V-Order Compression
description: Dataflow Gen2 will introduce a new preview capability that allows customers to disable V‑Order (VertiParquet) compression for supported workloads and destinations, giving advanced users greater control over execution behavior, performance characteristics, and cost trade‑offs.This capability is especially valuable for scenarios where write latency and refresh throughput are prioritized over downstream storage optimization. By disabling V‑Order compression, customers can reduce processing overhead during writes, helping accelerate refresh performance for large or time‑sensitive ingestion and transformation workloads.With this preview, organizations can better tune Dataflow Gen2 execution to meet the specific needs of their architectures and pipelines while continuing to leverage the scalability and flexibility of Microsoft Fabric.
